description: Static homepage value proposition content for MMIR.ai.

items.title: Low-friction start
items.description: Start with local or self-managed models, then add stronger backends when the need is clear.

items.title: Bring any model
items.description: Support open-source, on-prem, private-cloud and SaaS models through one controlled interface.

items.title: Role-based reasoning
items.description: Assign roles to models, compare answers, and synthesize the best final response.

items.title: Intelligence Well
items.description: The Edge Compute Mesh becomes a shared Intelligence Well: trusted CPUs, RAM, GPUs, local LLMs, tools and model capacity made available through MMIR.ai.

items.title: Well metrics
items.description: Show how strong the well is: connected nodes, available CPUs, RAM, GPUs, models, live capacity, latency and contribution credits.

items.title: Broad model potential
items.description: MMIR.ai can catalog many model families from Ollama-compatible local runtimes, open-source ecosystems, on-prem deployments and SaaS providers, while only enabled backends are marked available.

items.title: Safe control layer
items.description: Keep sensitive configuration behind controlled backend services while the frontend stays clean.
